chunks: And according to his chain of narration, he said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to eat the fresh date clusters (tal') and the date palm pith (jimar) along with the dried dates (tamr), and he would say: 'Indeed Satan, may God curse him, becomes very angry and says: 'The son of Adam has lived long enough until he eats the old (dried) dates.'

key_terms.الْجِمَار: Date palm pith or the inner core of the date cluster

ai.seo_question: Why does Satan get angry when the Prophet eats fresh and dried dates together?
ai.summary: This tradition, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the Prophetic practice of combining fresh dates (Tala') with dried ones (Jamar and Atiq) to prevent Satan from monopolizing the consumption of the latter. The scholarly context emphasizes that Satan's anger stems from the delay in consuming the 'old' dates, which were often stored for long periods and prone to spoilage or excess, thereby disrupting the natural rhythm of sustenance and gratitude.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-336 According to the same documentation, it is narrated that

the Prophet (S) used to eat dates along with the date palm pith and said, “Indeed Satan - may God’s Curse be upon him - will get angry at the descendants of Adam and say, ‘He is eating the fresh parts and the old parts together.’”
